world.name: Living Game World
world.description: A persistent shared game layer where player identity, progression, achievements, inventory, events and social presence can carry across compatible TryAMM games and experiences.

statusPolicy.concept: Defined in product architecture but not implemented as a playable game.

statusPolicy.prototype: A playable prototype exists but is not production complete.
statusPolicy.production: Playable, tested, deployed and monitored in production.
